purpose: Scoring-only reference curation for condition-locked known-reaction transfer tests; never prediction input.
development_status: Inspected transfer/development references, not a blind prospective holdout.
retention_note: This manifest retains source-backed metadata, explicitly labelled abstract-level author fits and access outcomes. No full primary article or correction was acquired, so no reproducible full-table transcription is claimed.
rules: An empty measured_rows list means measurements are not curated, not that the reaction has no experimental measurements.
Never substitute an author-fit evaluation or the NIST database's generated rate table for an individually measured row.
A reference cannot be locked for scoring until exact rows, conditions, units, uncertainty semantics and any corrections have been audited against primary documents.
References must remain outside prediction requests; bind the scoring artifact by its file hash.
Do not infer reaction-network completeness, product yields, atmospheric lifetime, general environmental support or an uncertainty distribution from these elementary-rate references.
Fit coefficients and their parameter errors are not independent per-temperature measurement errors; source correlations must be preserved.

cases.observable: forward elementary bimolecular rate coefficient k(T)

primary_source.citation: Rabinowitz, Sutherland, Patterson and Klemm, J. Phys. Chem. 95 (1991), 674-681.
primary_source.verified_scope: Publisher-indexed bibliographic metadata and title establish a direct flash-photolysis/shock-tube H/methane study over 897-1729 K.
primary_source.access: Publisher search-index metadata accessible; direct primary-page retrieval returned HTTP 403; body and numerical tables not audited.

required_corrections.citation: Rabinowitz, Sutherland, Patterson and Klemm, J. Phys. Chem. 96 (1992), 1010, correction to the H/methane study.
required_corrections.verification: ACS issue table of contents associates the correction title/authors with this DOI; direct correction retrieval was unavailable. Do not assume it changes only typography or only fit parameters.

secondary_retrieval_leads_not_primary_ev.kind: NIST database record, indexed text only; direct retrieval restricted by robots.txt
secondary_retrieval_leads_not_primary_ev.use: Locate original conditions and original two-parameter fit; not an audited numerical comparator.
secondary_retrieval_leads_not_primary_ev.temperature_rounding_caveat: NIST displays upper temperature 1730 K, versus 1729 K in the publisher title.
secondary_retrieval_leads_not_primary_ev.uncertainty_caveat: Database parameter errors differ from other indexed abstract transcriptions. Resolve using the original article and correction rather than selecting a convenient value.
secondary_retrieval_leads_not_primary_ev.generated_table_caveat: The database explicitly labels its T/k table as values calculated from the Arrhenius expression, not measured rows.

secondary_retrieval_leads_not_primary_ev.use: Distinguish broader reviewed/fitted temperature coverage from the original direct measurements; do not score it as a second independent experiment.

missing_evidence: Full original primary article with exact measurement table and page-level visual transcription audit.
Full 1992 correction and explicit reconciliation with the original measurements, rate fits and uncertainty.
Actual measured temperatures nearest the proposed 1000/1200/1500 K targets; no rounding of a fit table into measurements.
Primary pressure, bath composition/density, concentration ranges and state preparation for each retained row.
Primary treatment of secondary chemistry and any correction from observed atom decay to the elementary rate.
Rate units, measurement/fit uncertainty semantics, confidence level and shared calibration correlations.

cases.observable: forward elementary bimolecular rate coefficient k(T) and temperature dependence

primary_source.citation: Orkin, Kozlov, Poskrebyshev and Kurylo, J. Phys. Chem. A 110 (2006), 6978-6985.
primary_source.verified_scope: Primary publisher abstract: flash-photolysis resonance-fluorescence measurements over 200-479 K, non-Arrhenius temperature dependence, two author fits and an overall uncertainty factor.
primary_source.access: Publisher abstract accessible through web search; full methods and measurement tables not audited. NASA publication page reproduces the abstract but links only to the publisher for the full article.

cases.correction_search_status: No correction was identified in this bounded search; this is not a proof of absence.

author_fits.source_locator: Publisher abstract, high-temperature fit; also reproduced on NASA institutional abstract page.

author_fits.B_error_confidence_semantics: Not established by the accessible abstract; inspect full primary text.

uncertainty_factor_from_primary_abstract.caveat: Do not assign independent Gaussian errors from this factor; confidence and correlation semantics require primary-text audit.

secondary_retrieval_leads_not_primary_ev.kind: NIST database record, indexed text only; direct retrieval restricted by robots.txt
secondary_retrieval_leads_not_primary_ev.audit_status: Leads only; not promoted to primary-audited conditions or confidence semantics.
secondary_retrieval_leads_not_primary_ev.generated_table_caveat: NIST explicitly presents generated Arrhenius-expression values. Its exponent is rounded to 2.41; use neither these as measured rows nor rounded coefficients over the primary abstract's 2.406.

missing_evidence: Full primary numerical table and page-level visual audit of actual measured temperatures and rate constants.
Pressure/bath composition, H2 purity and ortho/para preparation, concentrations and OH preparation relevant to comparison.
Uncertainty confidence level and shared systematic/correlation model checked against primary text, not just database comments.
Primary account of secondary reactions and the measured decay-to-elementary-rate reduction.
Predeclared OH electronic-state and H2 nuclear-spin/rotational population assumptions for the prediction, compared with experimental preparation.

access_policy: Only publisher metadata/abstract and official institutional/database sources were used. No paywall bypass, article purchase, external issue, contact request, package installation or chemistry execution occurred.
next_reference_action: Provide lawful full copies of Rabinowitz 1991, its 1992 correction and Orkin 2006, or an accessible author/institutional archive; then audit exact selected rows and conditions before freezing scoring.
